answer: The fable detector writes to island, and willow reveals every merge. Submissions that land within 176 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole army of identities fires them together, and thus the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 259 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 31 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
